## Применимость к проектам

Перенесены явные документальные оценки. Это частичный охват проектов, не проверенный integration seam и не измеренная польза.

- [dsh-paper2agent](../../projects/dsh-paper2agent.md): DOCUMENTED_CANDIDATE; DOCUMENTED_CANDIDATE / NEEDS_EVIDENCE. Project purpose and source code show a plausible external research/source-discovery comparator, not a proven added-value deployment or integrated evidence pipeline. Ограничения: Source citations provide provenance metadata but not semantic support. Web search/local LLM claims need egress isolation, independent source verification and no private corpus/cloud leakage. No project runtime integration or measured benefit. Следующий тест: Compare incumbent A to LDR B isolated synthetic library and optional C public-web only after owner gate; frozen gold sources, blinded source-claim entailment evaluator, completeness, total cost, RAM/VRAM, network destinations; no prod or private data. [Основание](../../portfolio/2026-11-23/local-deep-research.md); предыдущая оценка: нет.
